## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also include relevant motivation, UI screenshots (via `tools/uiview.sh`), and hardware test results.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / Code Health
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Verified build with `./scripts/build-evoplayer.sh`
- [ ] UI rendered and verified via `./tools/uiview.sh <screen>`
- [ ] Tested on PlayStation 5 hardware or test suite
